title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.67 (quiet) at 23:00 UTC on 3 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 3 日 23:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.67（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.67 (1M) at 23:00 UTC on 3 October 2026. The 23:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 23:59; hour-start 0.67/1M, hour-end 1.33/1P). Last-180 maximum is 1.33 (first at 2026-10-03T23:57:00Z; label 1P). Published-window maximum is 1.33 (first at 2026-10-03T23:57:00Z; label 1P). Window start 2026-10-03T18:58:00Z (357 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 00 UTC on 2026-10-04 hour is still incomplete (55 samples through 00:54).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
